methodologyNotes: Published self-serve consumer VPN pricing was collected on the accessed date from each provider's own pricing page where it returned usable USD figures, and from dedicated 2026 pricing-review pages (primarily Security.org, corroborated by Cybernews/Tom's Guide aggregates) where the official page returned a 403/503 or geolocated to EUR. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD; consumer VPN accounts bundle a fixed number of simultaneous device connections (noted per tier) rather than charging per seat, so billingModel is flat throughout. Where a provider offers term-based pricing the lowest published rate (typically the 2-year term) is taken as monthlyUsd with the monthly/1-year rates and any bonus months recorded in notes; annualDiscountPct is left null because the headline rate is itself the multi-year promotional price. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer VPN service and are recorded null; minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.
